Maria Chen: FjordPay Dedicated switchover scheduled for 2026-03-29 02:00 UTC. Need final OKs for KV-cache pin, KMS rotation window, and rollback play. cc @Raj Patel @Sylvia Park
Raj Patel: Looking. KV pin: prefer 1h, can we do 45m instead? avoids long cold-cache while still safe
Maria Chen: 45m sounds fine if we prime the prefixes. ops-deploybot will do drain 30m pre-switchover
ops-deploybot: deploybot: planned drain at 01:30 UTC, canary slices = [slice-a,slice-b], est latency bump ~+50ms for ~10m
Sylvia Park: Security note — FjordPay's HSM team requested no KMS key rotation within 48h of cutover. We need to ensure our key-rotation cron is disabled for that tenant
Javier Morales: I can flip a tenant flag to disable rotation (keepalive: disabled-rotate). I’ll stage the change at 00:45 UTC and verify via smoke jobs
Raj Patel: Rollback plan: traffic-shift script points back to v2025-11 model; drain-addrs + health-check gating. I’ll run a dry-run tomorrow 12:00 UTC and post logs here
Maria Chen: Release notes for CS: quiet window 02:00–03:00 UTC, expected transient 3xx/5xx spike <1%, no data plane changes. Add that KMS rotation is paused for this tenant
Sylvia Park: +1 from security side if logs are retained for 48h post-switchover. Please enable extra debug for 2h after cutover
ops-deploybot: deploybot: dry-run scheduled 2026-03-28 12:00 UTC. Will emit results and canary metrics in this thread
Javier Morales: Patching infra flag in staging now, will promote to prod at 00:45 after verification. I’ll include steps in runbook
Raj Patel: I’ll validate KV-cache priming script against slices a/b at 11:30 UTC tomorrow; will report any cold-miss regressions
Maria Chen: OK — final thumbs? If no blockers I’ll mark GO at 21:00 UTC and update the release calendar + customer notes
Raj Patel: Raj Patel: +1
Sylvia Park: Sylvia Park: +1
Javier Morales: Javier Morales: +1
Maria Chen: Maria Chen: Marking as GO at 21:00 UTC unless anyone raises a new blocker. Attaching final runbook after dry-run. Thanks team :heart:
